## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 53 captures during August 2024. This represents the site’s capture activity for the month. The clinic lead has requested that recurring camera issues continue to be logged with the service desk so they can be monitored and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 5.7. This result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity for August 2024. Recurring camera issues should be recorded consistently, including where they may affect image quality or contribute to an ungradable outcome.

## Grading

Grading identified 17 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. The clinic should continue to ensure that images are submitted for grading promptly and that any recurring equipment concerns are logged with the service desk. This will support monitoring of both image quality and grading activity at North City Eye Clinic.
